sumoSquat.text: Wide-stance squat. Use a comfortably wider stance with toes turned slightly out. Bend knees in line with toes, keep whole feet grounded, and stand smoothly.

narrowSquat.text: Close-stance squat. Bring feet a little closer than your usual stance. Lower only through a comfortable range, keep heels grounded and stand with control.

wallSit.text: Shallow wall sit. Rest your back against a stable wall. Walk feet forward a little and bend knees to a comfortable shallow angle. Breathe throughout; stand to rest before form fades.

calfSingle.text: Supported single-leg calf raise. Hold a stable wall. Lift one foot a little and rise gently onto the other forefoot. Lower slowly. Change legs halfway; take support and rest whenever needed.

standingCrunch.text: Standing cross-body knee lift. Lift one knee and bring the opposite elbow gently toward it. Keep the range small, lower with control and alternate. Avoid pulling on your neck.

sideLegRaise.text: Standing side leg raise. Stand tall near a wall for balance. Lift one leg a little sideways without leaning, lower slowly and alternate. Keep toes facing forward.

backLegRaise.text: Standing hip extension. Stand tall near stable support. Move one leg a little behind you without arching your back, return and alternate. Keep the movement small.

frontKick.text: Low controlled front kick. Lift one knee a little, extend the lower leg forward without locking the knee, then lower and change sides. Keep kicks low and unhurried.

boxerStep.text: Boxer weight shift. Keep both feet grounded and knees soft. Shift your weight gently side to side while adding relaxed alternating punches. Keep elbows soft and use no weights.

stepReach.text: Diagonal step and reach. Take a small step diagonally forward with a comfortable opposite-arm reach. Return to the centre and change sides. Keep one foot grounded.

crossMarch.text: Opposite-hand knee march. March with each hand moving toward the opposite knee. Stay tall and move in a comfortable rhythm.

sideStep.text: Side step with reach. Step sideways, bring the other foot in and reach comfortably. Change direction. Keep steps soft.

doubleStep.text: Double side step. Take two small steps to one side, then two back. Stay upright and add an easy arm reach if comfortable.

punch.text: Straight-punch shadow boxing. Use light straight punches with relaxed shoulders. Keep elbows soft at the end of each punch. No weights.

uppercut.text: Light uppercut shadow boxing. With elbows bent, make small upward punches in front of you. Keep shoulders relaxed and avoid forceful twisting.

heelDig.text: Heel dig with arm swing. Place one heel lightly in front, bring it back, then alternate. Add a relaxed arm swing.

heelReach.text: Heel dig with reach. Alternate heel digs in front as your arms reach comfortably upward. Keep shoulders relaxed and arms below painful range.

toeTap.text: Side-to-side toe tap. Tap one toe lightly to the side, bring it back, then alternate. Keep your weight centred.

curl.text: Standing hamstring curl. Bend one knee to bring your heel back toward your buttock. Lower and alternate; keep knees near each other.

forwardMarch.text: Forward-and-back march. Take small marching steps forward and back in clear space. Stay balanced and face the same direction.

easyMarch.text: Easy march. March gently on the spot. Relax your shoulders and let your breathing settle.

circles.text: Shoulder circles and arm swings. Roll your shoulders gently and swing your arms through a comfortable range. Avoid forcing any movement.

ankle.text: Ankle rocks. Hold stable support. Gently shift weight from heels toward forefeet and back, keeping the movement small.

reach.text: Gentle arm reaches. Reach one arm, then the other, comfortably upward and forward. Keep your ribs relaxed.

stretchL.text: Supported calf stretch · left. Left leg behind with heel grounded, front knee slightly bent. Hold a wall. Feel a mild stretch; never force it.

stretchR.text: Supported calf stretch · right. Right leg behind with heel grounded, front knee slightly bent. Hold a wall. Feel a mild stretch; never force it.

breathe.text: Standing breathing and shoulder release. Stand comfortably. Breathe slowly and let your shoulders soften. Make small gentle shoulder movements.

chest.text: Comfortable chest opening. Stand tall with arms low. Gently draw shoulders back to open the chest without arching. Breathe naturally.

rest.text: Rest. Take a breath. Rest as long as you need.

switch.text: Change sides. Change your front leg now.

hamstringStretchL.text: Standing hamstring stretch · left. Place your left heel a little forward with toes raised and knee soft. Bend the other knee and hinge gently at the hips, hands resting lightly on the upper thigh. Keep your back long. Hold a mild stretch behind the thigh; do not bounce.

hamstringStretchR.text: Standing hamstring stretch · right. Place your right heel a little forward with toes raised and knee soft. Bend the other knee and hinge gently at the hips, hands resting lightly on the upper thigh. Keep your back long. Hold a mild stretch behind the thigh; do not bounce.

hipFlexorStretchL.text: Standing hip-flexor stretch · left. Put your left foot behind you in a short split stance with the rear heel raised. Use wall support. Keep your trunk upright, gently tuck your pelvis and soften the front knee. Hold a mild stretch at the front of the rear hip without arching your back.

hipFlexorStretchR.text: Standing hip-flexor stretch · right. Put your right foot behind you in a short split stance with the rear heel raised. Use wall support. Keep your trunk upright, gently tuck your pelvis and soften the front knee. Hold a mild stretch at the front of the rear hip without arching your back.

quadStretchL.text: Supported thigh stretch · left. Hold a wall with one hand. Bend your left knee and gently hold that ankle with the same-side hand. Keep knees close and your trunk upright. Hold a mild stretch at the front of the thigh. If you cannot comfortably reach your ankle, release and rest.

quadStretchR.text: Supported thigh stretch · right. Hold a wall with one hand. Bend your right knee and gently hold that ankle with the same-side hand. Keep knees close and your trunk upright. Hold a mild stretch at the front of the thigh. If you cannot comfortably reach your ankle, release and rest.

gluteStretchL.text: Supine knee-to-chest stretch · left. Lie on your back with knees bent and both feet grounded. Hold behind your left thigh and gently bring that knee toward your chest. Keep your head and other foot supported. Hold a comfortable stretch around the back of your hip; do not pull hard.

gluteStretchR.text: Supine knee-to-chest stretch · right. Lie on your back with knees bent and both feet grounded. Hold behind your right thigh and gently bring that knee toward your chest. Keep your head and other foot supported. Hold a comfortable stretch around the back of your hip; do not pull hard.

upperBackStretch.text: Gentle upper-back reach. Stand tall with knees soft. Bring your hands together in front at chest height and gently reach forwards. Let your shoulder blades move apart while keeping your neck relaxed. Hold a mild stretch across the upper back without forcing a rounded spine.
